lines.text: The psalm calls us to thank the LORD because He is good, and His loving devotion endures forever.
By His insight He made the heavens, and He made the sun to rule the night.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, divided the Red Sea, and swept Pharaoh and his army into it.
He led His people through the wilderness and struck down Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Moab.
He remembered us in our low estate, freed us from our enemies, and gives food to every creature.
